svg.title: Thinker inspects agent instructions, MCPs, and tools
svg.desc: Thinker scans a flat, front-facing Agent setup document on the left, with Instructions, MCPs, and Tools sections. Agent history appears to its right. Green setup entries are used. Amber entries are verbose, unused, or repeated. A red conflicting instruction stays flagged for review. A suggested-edits preview removes an unused MCP entry, compresses long instructions, and aliases repeated tool references to one retained definition. Thinker then visibly scans three history cards labeled Session 1, Session 2, and Session 3. The inspected sessions send a signal directly into a suggestion to use Browser Use for more efficient frontend work, with an illustrative estimate of about 1,200 tokens saved per task. History and savings are sample data, not a measured result. The 24-second loop honors reduced motion.
